info.title: OpenAsy Audience API
info.summary: One profile per person from every linked product, and segments that stay up to date.
info.description:
Every screen of Audience uses this API, and so can your scripts and the other products (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

People are matched only by email, phone number or your own user id, never by device fingerprints. How they are matched, the traits and the linked products are set in the product's file, never through the API. Every operation takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

The webhook `erasure` is the call Audience makes to Forms, CRM and Messages when a person is deleted on request.

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

post.description:
The API Forms, CRM, Messages and your own applications post their events to: up to 1000 at once, each matched to a person by email, phone or user id. The batch is checked whole; one event that cannot be read refuses all of them.

Needs the editor role.

200.description: Each event's person and whether it was new.

post.description:
A person and their traits, without an event, matched the same way.

Needs the editor role.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a name, email, phone number or user id.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Exactly this phone number, in any way it is written.

parameters.name: trait
parameters.description: name:value, such as plan:Free; case is ignored.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Only members of this segment at its last count.

get.description:
An id of a profile that was joined into another finds the person it is now.

Needs the viewer role.

200.description: The profile, its latest events and its segments.

delete.description:
For a request under KVKK Art. 7 and 11 or GDPR Art. 17. Deleted here at once and in every linked product with delete: true; logged in /api/v1/deletions without the person's data.

Needs the admin role.

202.description: Deleted here; the linked products' parts follow.

get.description:
Read from OpenAsy Consent by the person's emails, phone numbers and user id, when Consent is linked.

Needs the viewer role.

For a request under KVKK Art. 11 or GDPR Art. 15.

Needs the admin role.

200.description: With its size on each of the last 90 days.
Changed, and counted again when its rules changed.

get.description:
What Messages and Campaigns read to send to a segment. Evaluated at the moment of the first page, in profile id order; the cursor carries on after the last id. Each read is noted under usedBy. Consent is not checked here: the product that sends checks it.

Needs the viewer role.

id, name, email, phone, user_id and every trait in the file. Values a spreadsheet would run as a formula start with an apostrophe.

Needs the viewer role.

Oldest first after the cursor, kept 90 days; poll it with the cursor of the last answer to act when someone enters or leaves.

Needs the viewer role.

post.description:
The file is kept until it is imported or discarded. Commas, semicolons and tabs are read, with a header line. Up to 20 MiB and 100,000 rows.

Needs the editor role.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file's name, for the list of imports.

201.description: Its columns, the first value of each and the mapping offered.

post.description:
Rows are matched to people here; a row without anything to match by is skipped. The file is deleted afterwards; the counts stay.

Needs the editor role.

get.description:
The log: references, times, who recorded them and how much was deleted where. Nobody's data.

Needs the viewer role.

post.description:
By profile id, or by identifiers, also for someone who has no profile here but may have one in a linked product.

Needs the admin role.

202.description: Deleted here; the linked products' parts follow.

post.summary: Try the linked products again now
post.description:
After a token or an address was fixed.

Needs the admin role.

200.description: Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

post.summary: Delete a person in a linked product
post.description: Audience calls `POST {url}/api/v1/erasures` on Forms, CRM and Messages, with the product's token from the file, when a person is deleted on request. Answer 200 with status done once they are deleted, or 202 with status waiting and a detail while the product must keep them (an unpaid invoice, a legal hold); Audience asks again every hour with the same reference. A 401 or 403 stops it until someone fixes the token; anything 5xx is tried again later.

202.description: Kept for now; detail says why.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when Audience runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the Audience origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings, API tokens (`oa_audience_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when Audience is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

ConfigFile.description: The file and whether it is applied; null before it was first read.

url.description: Where Audience calls it: the file's url, or the product's address in OPENASY_PRODUCTS.

token.description: The environment variable the token is read from, and whether it is set.

delete.description: People deleted on request here are deleted there too.

events7d.description: Events from it in the last 7 days.

trend.description: Profiles there are now, at the end of each of the last 14 days.

deletions.description: Deletions with a linked product's part pending, waiting, done or failed.

PersonInput.description: At least one of the identifiers the file matches by. Emails are lowercased, phone numbers written as +905551112233.

email.description: The first email; every one is in emails.

traits.description: Trait names and values, as the file declares them.

mergedFrom.description: Ids of profiles that turned out to be this person.

events.description: The latest 50, newest first; the rest at /api/v1/people/{id}/events.

segments.description: The segments the person meets now.

total.description: How many match, on every page.

linked.description: Whether Consent is linked in the file.

error.description: Why Consent could not be asked.

source.description: forms, crm and messages only once linked under sources in the file.

type.description: What happened, such as form_submitted, deal_opened or message_opened.

at.description: When it happened; now by default. At most a day ahead.

id.description: The source's own id for the event: the same id from the same source is kept once.

traits.description: Traits to set as of at; null removes one. Traits the file does not declare, or does not take from this source, are left out and listed in ignoredTraits.

properties.description: Up to 4096 bytes of JSON. Segments compare its top-level values.

merged.description: Profiles joined into it: they shared an email, a phone number or the user id.

conflicts.description: Identifiers given that belong to someone with another user id, so they were not added.

Condition.description: A group (all: every condition holds; any: at least one does), a trait compared with a value, a count of events of a type ever or in the last days days, or whether the person has an identifier.

owner.description: Who made it: a member's email or token:<name>.

size.description: People in it at the last count; it follows events as they come in.

period.description: Its rules have a period, so people leave it as days pass; counted again on a timer.

usedBy.description: Who read its members in the last 30 days, such as token:messages.

traits.description: Trait names and values, as the file declares them.

cursor.description: Pass it back to read only what changed since; given on every page, empty or not.

sample.description: The first value in the column.

suggested.description: email, phone, user_id, name, trait:<name> or skip.

mapping.description: Each column to email, phone, user_id, name, trait:<name> or skip. At least one column to match by.

problems.description: The first 20 rows with a value that could not be read; row 2 is the first after the header.

state.description: waiting: the product keeps the person for now and is asked again every hour; failed: it needs someone to act, see detail.

reference.description: The request's own reference, such as KVKK-2026-031.

DeletionRequest.description: The person by profile, or by person: every profile with any of the identifiers is deleted, and they are passed to the linked products.
